subject: science
domain: From Molecules to Organisms: Structures and Processes
skillName: Life Cycles of Plants and Animals

items.prompt:
A life cycle is
A) the stages an organism goes through in its life
B) a type of bicycle
C) only how fast something moves
D) a kind of rock
items.answer: A) the stages an organism goes through in its life

steps: A life cycle is the stages from birth to death.

items.prompt:
Which stage do all life cycles share?
A) Flying
B) Growth
C) Swimming
D) Glowing

steps: Birth, growth, reproduction, and death are shared by all.

items.prompt:
A frog begins its life as an
A) adult
B) egg
C) tadpole with legs
D) seed

steps: A frog's life cycle starts with an egg.

items.prompt:
The stage that means making new living things is
A) death
B) reproduction
C) growth
D) birth

A plant's life cycle is drawn as a circle because
A) plants are round
B) new seeds start the stages over
C) it never ends
D) circles are pretty
items.answer: B) new seeds start the stages over

items.prompt:
A butterfly goes egg to caterpillar to chrysalis to
A) seed
B) adult butterfly
C) tadpole
D) frog

steps: The chrysalis becomes an adult butterfly.

items.prompt:
A frog and a plant have different-looking life cycles but both
A) have no stages
B) are born or sprout, grow, reproduce, and die
C) stay the same forever
D) skip reproduction
items.answer: B) are born or sprout, grow, reproduce, and die

steps: They share the four common stages despite looking different.

items.prompt:
Which statement is correct?
A) Only animals have life cycles
B) All organisms have life cycles with birth, growth, reproduction, and death
C) Plants have no life cycle
D) Life cycles have no common stages
items.answer: B) All organisms have life cycles with birth, growth, reproduction, and death

steps: Every organism shares the four common stages.
